raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang declares only `reasoning_content`, so assistant reasoning replayed as `reasoning` is silently dropped and the next prompt loses it. Clients using that name, which vLLM reads, hit this (listed in RFC #47763), but I have no captured request. A client echoing SGLang's reply sends `reasoning_content` and is unaffected. In a Qwen3-0.6B tool loop (one B200, cookbook parsers, main `ba1ed00dfe`), main builds a 199-token prompt from that replay, identical to no reasoning, and this PR builds 307, identical to `reasoning_content`, with matching next output.

#47271 (Mistral-Large-4, not run here) adds the same Python validator for assistant messages, but no router or Rust change, so the `Router from main` column would still apply. If both merge, one validator can go. #44942 targets the `thinking` key and #47175 changes responses only.

## Modifications

A string `reasoning` fills a missing or null `reasoning_content`. Explicit `reasoning_content` wins, and a non-string `reasoning` stays ignored.

- Python and `rust/sglang-processor` apply this rule, so DeepSeek-V4, V4.1, GLM-5.3, Kimi-K3 and Qwen3.8 render the same prompt everywhere. MiniMax-M3 and M3.1, newer than this head, share that code and should too.
- For other models, the sgl-router guard sends the request to the engine.

Limits:

- For those models, routing tokens omit the alias, which can change the chosen worker and router token count, but not the prompt.
- The Rust server's typed parse covers those models and requests the lowered `/generate` route declines, such as `tool_choice: required`. On Qwen3-0.6B it gives 35 for `reasoning` alone, but returns 400 for both fields, `reasoning` with a null `reasoning_content`, or an object `reasoning`. No captured client request reaches this, and #47175 adds it only for a Python reply replayed to a Rust server.

## Accuracy Tests

Token counts for a `reasoning` replay through a real sgl-router (head `eb31ca9581`, main `c757c4bb7c`):

| Worker and model | Router from main | Router at this head | `reasoning_content` at this head |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Real engine on one B200, Qwen3-0.6B, final turn `<tool_response>` | 23 | 35 | 35 |
| Stub, GLM-5.3-Flash | 19 | 23 | 23 |
| Stub, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 69 | 74 | 74 |
| Stub, Kimi-K3 | 125 | 129 | 129 |
| Stub, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with tools and thinking | 284 | 288 | 288 |

The stub models' `reasoning_alias` parity cases fail on main with `prompt differs` and pass here.

Not run: accuracy evaluation (only prompt history changes), real weights on any `rust/sglang-processor` model, `reasoning_alias` cases on DeepSeek-V4, MiniMax-M3 and other checkpoints, and runtime CI (no `run-ci` label).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    @model_validator(mode="before")
+    @classmethod
+    def _accept_reasoning_alias(cls, data):
+        # vLLM accepts prior thinking as `reasoning`; keep it for the chat template.
+        if (
+            isinstance(data, dict)
+            and data.get("reasoning_content") is None
+            and isinstance(data.get("reasoning"), str)
+        ):
+            data = {**data, "reasoning_content": data["reasoning"]}
+        return data
